training_scope: 14 TSA 23 IDF training plots plus 19 regional high-biomass IDF plots; second-order log-volume terms.
source: FAIB PSP (OGL-BC) and LidarBC (OGL-BC); FEMIC regional nonlinear fit 2026-10-31.

applicability.notes: Experimental nonlinear volume candidate. Independent BC IDF check: 44 in-range plots, volume RMSE 62.93 m3/ha. Four-plot TSA 23 high-biomass external check was 42.09. No independent TSA 23 plot falls inside the volume predictor range. Not operational.

caveats: Four-plot high-biomass external check is not the full validation set.
Independent BC IDF check has 44 in-range plots, volume RMSE 62.93 m3/ha.
No independent TSA 23 volume plot is inside the predictor range; do not extrapolate.
